shortDefinition: An isolated app instance in Melusina OS with its own capability URL and boundaries.

children.text: A Pearl is the atomic unit of computing in Melusina OS. Each Pearl is a single instance of an app—one document, one notebook, one portal—running in an isolated container with its own capability URL.
Isolation: syscall and network sandboxing per Pearl.
Sharing: access is granted through capability URLs, not global ACLs.
Portability: any Linux app packaged as an SPK can run as Pearls.

seo.title: Pearl (Melusina OS)
seo.description: Definition of a Pearl, the isolated app unit in Melusina OS.
